name: probe_activation_trace
description: Probe dynamic token activations and internal residual states during inference on a diagnostic prompt. Detects loop attractors, attention spikes, and anomalous firing rates to locate the malfunctioning circuit prior to patching.

path.description: Absolute filesystem path to the model.

prompt.description: Diagnostic prompt that triggers the anomalous model behavior.

target_layers.description: List of layer indices to hook and observe.

max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens to execute for trace capture.
